cases.description: A known Draft‑04 schema URI should be resolved to VersionFlag.V4 wrapped in an Optional.
A known Draft‑06 schema URI should be resolved to VersionFlag.V6 wrapped in an Optional.
A known Draft‑07 schema URI should be resolved to VersionFlag.V7 wrapped in an Optional.
An unknown schema URI should not match any VersionFlag and therefore return an empty Optional.
A null argument should be handled gracefully and result in an empty Optional (no exception is thrown).
An empty string does not correspond to any known version and should return an empty Optional.
If the method does not trim whitespace, a URI with leading/trailing spaces should be considered unknown and return an empty Optional.
A known Draft‑2019‑09 schema URI should be resolved to VersionFlag.V201909 wrapped in an Optional.
A known Draft‑2020‑12 schema URI should be resolved to VersionFlag.V202012 wrapped in an Optional.
The detector accepts the same Draft‑2020‑12 URI over HTTP (not only HTTPS).
A known draft URI missing the trailing ‘#’ fragment is not recognised and returns an empty Optional.
A known draft URI with additional characters after the ‘#’ fragment is considered unknown.
URI scheme is case‑sensitive; an upper‑case “HTTP” should not match any VersionFlag.
Internal whitespace inside the URI breaks the pattern, resulting in an empty Optional.
Leading newline and trailing tab characters are not trimmed; the method should return empty.
A string consisting solely of whitespace characters should be treated as unknown.

input.description: A very long unknown string should be handled without error and return Optional.empty().
